description_en: Deletes configurations for multiple accelerated domain names
description_zh: 调用BatchDeleteCdnDomainConfig批量删除加速域名的配置
kebab_example: aliyun cdn batch-delete-cdn-domain-config --domain-names example.com,example.org --function-names referer_white_list_set,https_force --region cn-hangzhou
name: BatchDeleteCdnDomainConfig

parameters.help_en:
The accelerated domain names whose configurations you want to delete. Separate multiple domain names with a comma (,). Note the following limits:

You can specify up to 20 domain names in each request.

The number of domain names multiplied by the number of feature names cannot exceed 50
parameters.help_zh:
需要删除配置的加速域名，多个用半角逗号（,）分隔，注意以下配置限制：

一次最多传20个域名。
域名个数乘以 FunctionNames个数，小于等于50
parameters.name: domain_names

parameters.help_en: The feature names that you want to delete. Separate multiple feature names with a comma (,). You can specify up to 50 feature names in each request. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/388460.html
parameters.help_zh: 需要删除的功能函数名称，多个用半角逗号（,）分隔，一次传入最多50个。更多功能名称，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/388460.html
parameters.name: function_names
